row.notes: For each retired entry (+0x3f8..+0x400: vehicle index byte, timer float +4): once timer >= this+0x414 hides the car (car+0x54 = 0, car+0x17d bit 0x80) and marks done; otherwise fades with a cosine curve over (+0x410 - +0x414).
